item.title: Version 1.0
item.description:
The first release of Clipper: everything you copy, for ten days.

  • Every copy is kept in a list you can copy from again, with where it came from and when. Click the clipboard in the menu bar, or press ⇧⌘V anywhere.
  • Text, links, code, colors, images and files, in the same themes as Tracker.
  • Clips are archived after a day and deleted after ten. Pin the ones you want to keep.
  • Passwords are never recorded, and everything stays on your Mac.
